description: List the workspace's suppliers: id, name, status (active or archived), the currency they invoice in and how many products each covers (productCount). Read-only. Use it as the id source for a {kind:'supplier'} scope of preview_bulk_price_change and apply_bulk_price_change — 'raise every Sipec product by 5%'. Categories, brands and warehouses come from list_categories, list_brands and list_warehouses.
name: list_suppliers
title: List suppliers
